# sonarqube_group_member (Resource)

Membership of one user in one group. Import ID: `group[login]`. On an instance with GitHub, GitLab or SCIM `AUTO_PROVISIONING`, SonarQube refuses to add or remove members, so adding one fails at plan time, and destroying one only removes it from state, with a warning.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sonarqube_group" "developers" {
  name = "developers"
}

resource "sonarqube_group_member" "alice" {
  name       = sonarqube_group.developers.name
  login_name = "alice"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `login_name` (String) User login.
- `name` (String) Group name.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of this resource in Terraform state.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import sonarqube_group_member.example 'developers[alice]'
```
